method: Exact small integer decoding and symbolic integer inequalities; no execution of textbook recursive proof predicates.

extra_node_field_witnesses.limitation: Small fields demonstrate shape only; these numbers are not claimed to contain genuine sentence or sequent codes.

axiomatic_noncanonical_witness.general_code: 5*2^(a+1), with a the code of a genuine axiom

one_assumption_counterexample.sentence_code: a = Gn(A), for any sentence A
one_assumption_counterexample.old_strict_bound: s<S is false; OpenAssum(a,D) is false
one_assumption_counterexample.old_empty_theory_Prfgamma: The old open-assumption test accepts D as a proof from the empty theory, including when A is not a theorem.

general_path_bound: Every genuine child code is smaller than its positive parent code. A root-to-leaf path therefore has at most D nodes, each at most D. Canonical tuple reconstruction gives s<=p_(D-1)^(D*(D+1))=sequenceBound(D,D), including the singleton path.
scope_limitations: Checks address the stated counterexamples and general path bound. Rule soundness, a formal implementation of all proof predicates, full corpus semantics and independent human review are not claimed.
